statistical_unit: For each path, average absolute error over five checkpoints; summarize across 100 paths. Seed SD is computed separately across five seed-specific MAEs.
paired_test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on 100 path-level paired errors; Holm adjustment over the three systems; percentile bootstrap CI for mean paired reduction.
checkpoint_policy: Binary checkpoint archives are retained in the companion revision package, not committed to Git.
caveat: Historical ten-path checkpoints and exact test paths were not recovered; earlier reported main-table values are superseded and not authenticated as outcomes under the observed-noisy-increment target.
